descriptions: 500ml bottle with double wall vacuum keeps drinks cold 24 hours or hot 12 hours.
Natural bamboo lid with leak proof seal on BPA free 18/8 stainless steel body.
Fits most car cup holders and covered by 1 year warranty. Hand wash the lid.
Pure stainless steel construction with natural bamboo lid for eco-friendly hydration.
long_headline: ["500ml BPA Free Stainless Steel Bottle with Natural Bamboo Lid Keeps Drinks Hot or Cold"]
